notes.title: Rita Demo Launch
notes.content:
Demo launch for Rita 🐤
A Cozy Word-puzzle Adventure.

Find letters

Solve puzzles

Unlock the world

Learn her story

We're so thrilled that the Rita Demo is ready for public consumption. Take a look at some of our favourite streamers in action above, or jump right in and crack some puzzles for yourself! Rita is waiting to share her story with you. 🧡



Play along: Download the demo from the store page and try it for yourself. 

Support the game: Wishlist & Follow Rita on Steam.

Share feedback: Discuss in the Community Hub.

notes.title: The Game Expo
notes.content:
Rita is heading to The Game Expo (https://www.thegameexpo.com/) in Melbourne on 22-23 March 2025!

Come say hello and play the new demo, featuring:

 Full controller support - sit back and relax
 Brand new dynamic sound track
 Store and lore behind the mysterious "memory worlds"
 New puzzles to solve

As well as Postcards to collect, SporkTank Puzzle of the Day, Mini 3D Ritas, and a Life-sized Rita!

See you there! 🐤🧩🧡
